source.content: @isTest private class AssertOverloadFixtureTest { @isTest static void overloads() { System.Assert.areEqual('a', 'a'); System.Assert.areEqual(true, true, 'same'); System.Assert.areNotEqual('a', 'b'); System.Assert.areNotEqual(true, false, 'different'); System.Assert.isFalse(false); System.Assert.isFalse(false, 'false'); System.Assert.isTrue(true); System.Assert.isTrue(true, 'true'); System.Assert.isNull(null); System.Assert.isNull(null, 'null'); System.Assert.isNotNull('value'); System.Assert.isNotNull('value', 'not null'); System.Assert.isInstanceOfType('value', String.class); System.Assert.isInstanceOfType('value', String.class, 'type'); System.Assert.isNotInstanceOfType('value', Account.class); System.Assert.isNotInstanceOfType('value', Account.class, 'type'); } @isTest static void failNoMessage() { System.Assert.fail(); } @isTest static void failStringMessage() { System.Assert.fail('forced'); } }
